shadows.name: card-separation
shadows.purpose: Separate dense translucent cards without heavy elevation.

shadows.name: transient-layer
shadows.purpose: Lift search results and dialogs above the card wall.

motion.name: state-standard
motion.purpose: Hover, focus, collapse and surface feedback.

narrative.overview: DesktopDock is a quiet, dense Windows companion surface attached to the desktop edge. The wallpaper remains visible beside it and subtly passes through its Acrylic layers.

rules.name: The Wallpaper-Through Rule
rules.body: The panel canvas and ordinary cards remain translucent.

rules.name: The Quiet Elevation Rule
rules.body: Resting cards use a hairline border and translucency; shadows only separate transient layers.

dos: Keep the panel anchored to the right desktop layer.
Preserve 4px gaps and real shortcut icons.
donts: Add a conventional titlebar or bottom navigation.
